sourcedFrom: 590R™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106250, Manual Draft Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 (2024)
cleanIntro: A 590R is a tube-fed 590 wearing a rotary selector, and both halves of that change the start of the job. The tube empties through the cartridge stop rather than by dropping a magazine, and the selector is confirmed by reading the receiver rather than feeling a detent at the tang. Once it is empty the strip is the familiar one: nut, barrel, one punch.

steps.title: Selector to SAFE, and nothing on the trigger
steps.action: Rotate the Safety Selector fully to SAFE, muzzle somewhere harmless, and keep fingers and objects off the trigger for the whole unload.
steps.quote: Move the Safety Selector fully to the SAFE position. During unloading, never allow fingers or any other objects to contact the Trigger.
steps.cite: 590R™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106250, Manual Draft Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — UNLOADING THE FIREARM, p.15

steps.title: Chambered round out FIRST — slowly, and by hand
steps.action: Press up on the action release lever and draw the forearm back SLOWLY until the live shell is fully withdrawn and you can see it in the ejection port, then lift it out by hand. Slow is the instruction: racking hard throws a live round across the room.
steps.quote: Press upwards on the Action Release Lever and pull the Forearm rearward, slowly, until the live shotshell is completely withdrawn and visible in the ejection port. Remove shotshell by hand.
steps.cite: 590R™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106250, Manual Draft Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — UNLOADING THE FIREARM, p.15

steps.title: Next shell onto the elevator, then tip it out
steps.action: Pull the forearm fully back to release the next shell onto the elevator, then turn the gun so the ejection port faces down and let it fall clear. Close the action on an empty chamber before going further.
steps.quote: Turn the Firearm so that the ejection port faces downward to allow the released shotshell to drop out through the ejection port.
steps.cite: 590R™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106250, Manual Draft Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — UNLOADING THE FIREARM, p.15

steps.title: ⛔ Now the tube — invert it and work the CARTRIDGE STOP, one at a time
steps.action: Turn the gun trigger-guard-up, put your thumb into the opening in the bottom of the receiver and depress the cartridge stop on the RIGHT side. One shell releases each time. Repeat until the tube is empty. This is the step that has no equivalent on a box-magazine 590 — there is nothing to drop out, and a tube that looks empty from the muzzle end rarely is.
steps.quote: Insert your thumb into the opening in the bottom of the Receiver and depress the Cartridge Stop on the right side to release shotshells one at a time (Figure 7).
steps.cite: 590R™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106250, Manual Draft Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — UNLOADING THE FIREARM, p.15

steps.title: Open, look and feel in all three places, leave it open
steps.action: Press up on the action release, pull the forearm fully rearward and check chamber, receiver and magazine tube by eye and by finger. Leave the action open and the selector on SAFE — that is the state the strip begins from.
steps.quote: Leave the action in the open, rearward position and the Safety Selector fully in the SAFE position.
steps.cite: 590R™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106250, Manual Draft Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — UNLOADING THE FIREARM, p.15

steps.title: Glasses on — splatter and sprung parts
steps.action: The book names both hazards by name and there is a magazine spring in the tube you have just been working against.
steps.quote: Wear eye protection during disassembly and cleaning to protect your eyes from oil splatter or spring loaded components.
steps.cite: 590R™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106250, Manual Draft Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — DISASSEMBLY, p.16

steps.title: Bolt to mid-port, then the take-down nut off
steps.action: Walk the forearm slowly forward until the bolt face sits in the middle of the ejection port, then turn the take-down nut counterclockwise. If an M-Lok adapter is fitted, pull it forward off the tube once the nut is clear.
steps.quote: Remove the Take-down Nut by turning it counterclockwise. If present, remove the optional M-Lok Adapter by pulling it forward (Figure 8).
steps.cite: 590R™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106250, Manual Draft Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — DISASSEMBLY, p.16

steps.title: Barrel out with a rocking pull
steps.action: Small back-and-forth rotations while drawing the barrel forward out of the receiver. A straight pull binds the extension in its seat.
steps.quote: Remove the Barrel with a gentle back-and-forth rotational movement while pulling the Barrel out of the Receiver.
steps.cite: 590R™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106250, Manual Draft Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — DISASSEMBLY, p.16

steps.title: ⛔ Selector to FIRE before the trigger housing pin — not optional
steps.action: Rotate the Safety Selector fully to FIRE. The selector passes through the housing on this gun, and with it on SAFE the housing is mechanically locked in the receiver. The gun is empty and open by now; forcing a locked housing is the actual hazard here.
steps.quote: Move the Safety Selector fully in the FIRE position.
steps.cite: 590R™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106250, Manual Draft Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — DISASSEMBLY, p.16

steps.title: Trigger housing pin — 1/8" punch, forward then up
steps.action: Drive the trigger housing pin out with a punch no larger than 1/8", slide the housing FORWARD first, then up and out. Lifting before sliding jams it against the receiver.
steps.aside: The Trigger Housing Assembly is complex and must not be disassembled.
steps.quote: Using a small punch, no larger than 1/8” diameter, push out the Trigger Housing Pin.
steps.cite: 590R™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106250, Manual Draft Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — DISASSEMBLY, p.16

deepAbsentReason: The 590R book publishes one teardown and stops at the field strip; the trigger housing is declared complex and not to be disassembled. ⛔ No deeper path is invented for it.

cleaning.name: TUBE, BOLT AND ACTION BARS
tasks: Solvent through the bore and chamber, patches until clean
Bolt face, extractor and the receiver's action-bar tracks
Wipe the magazine tube's outside where the forearm rides
Light oil, wiped back — a pump runs better dry than wet
cleaning.quote: Wear eye protection during disassembly and cleaning to protect your eyes from oil splatter or spring loaded components.
cleaning.src: 590R™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual, DISASSEMBLY, p.16

reassembly: Trigger housing in from above, slid rearward into engagement, pin flush.
Selector back to SAFE once the housing is home.
Barrel into the receiver with the same rocking motion that took it out.
M-Lok adapter, if fitted, back on the tube before the nut.
Function test before it goes away.
fncheck: Selector to SAFE and confirm it points at SAFE on the receiver. Open the action and check chamber, receiver and magazine tube. Cycle the action several times for free travel. Closed and on SAFE, pull the trigger — no hammer fall. Finger off, rotate to FIRE — it must not fall on its own; then the trigger should drop it. ⛔ Confirm the selector sits fully in a detent and not between positions.
